title: Expensive Shit
studio_context: Title track of the 1975 LP (Soundworkshop), written after the police tried to plant evidence on Fela.

drum_performances.name: Tony Allen
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Peak Africa 70: his first pattern answered by kick and snare over two bars, held for the length of the side.

drums.description: Two bars: his first pattern, then kick and snare answering it, a call and response inside the drum part.
